verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a workflow and task orchestration platform, so a built-in AI assistant in its dashboard or CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence shows only that it orchestrates user-built AI agents and exposes workflows as tools for external agent SDKs (Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK), plus agent cookbooks. Those are developer building blocks, not an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
